description: This file contains utility functions for handling SPDY/HTTP2 headers in the QUIC protocol implementation, including header extraction, validation, and URL header population.

methods.name: ExtractContentLengthFromHeaders
methods.description: Extracts and validates the Content-Length header from HTTP headers.

methods.name: CopyAndValidateHeaders
methods.description: Copies headers from a list to a header block and validates header names and content length.

methods.name: CopyAndValidateTrailers
methods.description: Copies trailer headers, validates pseudo-headers, and checks for required final offset header.

methods.name: PopulateHeaderBlockFromUrl
methods.description: Populates HTTP/2 header block with URL components.

methods.name: ExtractQuicVersionFromAltSvcEntry
methods.description: Extracts QUIC version from Alt-Svc entry based on supported versions.
